name: M6.EuclidStorage.layout_bound
statement: ∀ N : ℕ, M6.EuclidStorage.polynomialSlots.length = 4 ∧ M6.EuclidStorage.controlSlots.length = 16 ∧ M6.EuclidStorage.actualPreprocessStorage N ≤ 512*(N+1)^2
